# Fixtures

**Status: SYNTHETIC.** Built from the documented ALeRCE response models (docs/alerce-notes.md) and anchored to `2026-11-01T00:00:00Z` (MJD 61345.0). The LSST list fields are a guess, since ALeRCE doesn't document them.

Replace these with real samples from the **Explore ALeRCE** workflow artifact (`*_objects.json`, `*_probabilities.json`, `ztf_classifiers.json`) once the repo is live. Tests that depend on specific values use their own inline data. Fixture-driven tests only assert shape and invariants, so swapping in real data should not break them.
